data.title: COMDEX 1982 — Logix professional graphics and Autodesk AutoCAD

actions.description: Jointly present the release-quality AutoCAD 1.0 Artemis/AIONix build on the professional dual-display system with mouse and physical plotted drawings. Target commercial readiness for COMDEX; ship only after acceptance. Historical AutoCAD 1.0 shipped in December; a November Artemis release is an explicit funded alternate-history acceleration, not a historical claim. Programme details: team_development_program.json.

Present the accepted Professional CAD offering and November professional-card revision, including legacy modes, five sprites with separate SRAM, 512-entry palette list and qualified Ball HD17H analog configuration. Proposed campaign: A clear view of your next design. Demonstrate the same drawing from entry through saved file to plotted output. Details: comdex_1982_campaign.json; no final price assumed before revised costing and Autodesk terms.
